positions.name: Sprint4SuccessEvidenceReport
positions.frame: what evidence does this retro offer that the sprint delivered measurable product success?
positions.why: All three expressions are flat, unhedged past-tense assertions (conviction: claim throughout, temporal: past/realis/concrete throughout) reporting concrete pieces of the same sprint outcome — a shipped artifact, a quantified velocity result, and a causal attribution for that result. Read together they form a single evidentiary report of the sprint's success rather than three unrelated facts; the register stays matter-of-fact even on the superlative claim, so the group coheres as understated substantiation rather than celebratory narrative.
